description: Generic Windows Event Log text block (wevtutil/Get-WinEvent /f:text). Catch-all for any Log Name/Source/Event ID block not claimed by a specialized Event-ID parser. Caps at 0.9 so specialized parsers (which add known_processes → 1.0) win.
sample_log:
Log Name:      Application
Source:        Application Error
Event ID:      1000
Level:         Error
User:          CORP\jsmith
Computer:      WKS01.corp.local
Description:   Faulting application name: app.exe
